lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-luminance circular clusters arranged in semi-regular vertical columns along the mid-lateral flank. Blobs exhibit high pixel intensity (near-white) against a lower-luminance background.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Subtle vertical bands of elevated luminance intersect with the highest-intensity blobs, creating a visible grid-like pattern across the posterior-lateral region.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A distinct horizontal ridge running across the upper third of the visible flank, defined by a sharp luminance transition from a high-intensity dorsal highlight to a low-intensity ventral shadow.
